nomad._comment: Nomad agent install source. repoUrl empty => install from the bundled vendor/nomad-src (offline; main.js sets HM_NOMAD_SRC). packageName matches pyproject [project].name.

cloud._comment: The friend's local agent routes ALL LLM traffic through the owner's cloud control-plane (OpenAI-compatible). baseUrl is written into HERMES_HOME/config.yaml as a custom provider. defaultModel MUST be a model id that cp.nomadnet.ai/v1/models actually serves — confirm and adjust. The friend pastes their OWN cabinet key; the owner's key is NEVER embedded.

dashboard._comment: Local Nomad web dashboard. `nomad dashboard` starts the SPA + API on this port.

finish._comment_pairing: pairingDoc empty => the finish screen shows a short inline how-to for controlling the agent from a phone.
